device.description: 14-bit 1 MSPS unipolar SAR ADC with SPI/DSP serial interface and daisy chain
device.note: ads7279.pdf (SBAS436A, ADS7279/ADS7280) p.3-7 electrical characteristics (+VBD 1.65-5.5 V), p.9 timing at +VBD = 1.8 V, p.10-11 pin assignments and terminal functions, p.25-26 converter operation, conversion start, EOC/INT, p.27-28 power-down, p.31-33 digital interface (Table 3 CMR commands, Table 4 CFR, Table 5 codes, TAG), p.33-36 chain mode, Table 6, p.37 reset

registers.name: CFR
registers.note: p.32 Table 4: configuration register, default all 1s (ADS7279: D1 ignored, reads 0); no address (CMR commands 1100b/1110b/1111b)

registers.name: CHSEL
registers.note: internal: the channel chosen by the CMR select-channel commands 0h/1h (ADS7280)

commands.name: Select analog input channel 0
commands.note: p.31 Table 3: single-channel ADS7279 (channel 0 only); wakes from auto nap

commands.name: Wake up
commands.note: p.31-32: sets CFR D3 and D2 to 1

commands.name: Read CFR
commands.note: p.31: the read-back is the first four result MSBs then the 12-bit CFR

commands.name: Write CFR (D0 = 0: system reset)
commands.note: p.32 Table 4 D0: 0 = system reset (all registers to default, all 1s)

commands.name: Write CFR
commands.note: p.31: 4-bit command plus 12 bits of CFR data, effective at the 16th SCLK falling edge

commands.name: Default mode (load CFR with default value)
commands.note: p.31-32: CFR loaded with all 1s at the 4th falling edge (SDI tied to +VBD gives this every cycle)

pages: p.2 (ordering: RSA QFN-16, PW TSSOP-16), p.3-7 (electrical characteristics, +VBD 1.65-5.5 V, digital inputs to +VBD + 0.3 V), p.9 (timing at +VBD = 1.8 V: internal CCLK 20 MHz min, tD1 16 ns, tD2 13 ns, tD3 8 ns), p.10-11 (pin drawings and terminal functions), p.25-26 (18-CCLK conversion, CONVST falling edge, Table 1, EOC/INT), p.31 (digital interface, Table 3), p.32 (Table 4 CFR), p.32-33 (data format, Table 5 straight binary, 14-bit result then 00, TAG), p.36 (Table 6), p.37 (reset)
notModeled: analog input and external reference: every conversion returns the 0 V code 0000h

conversion time is 18 CCLK at the 20 MHz minimum internal clock (900 ns); CCLK = SCLK/2 (CFR D10 = 0), the 21-CCLK auto-trigger cycle (D9 = 0) and the minimum CONVST spacing are not timed; with auto trigger the model converts back to back every 900 ns (the text quotes 857 ns at a 21 MHz internal clock; the 1.8 V timing table gives 20 MHz minimum)
quiet zone around end of sampling and the pipelined result (reading before end of conversion gives the previous result): the model always outputs the constant 0 V code
SDO outputs all 1s during the first cycle after power-on or software reset (the model outputs the normal frame)
daisy-chain mode (CFR D5 = 0: EOC/INT/CDI becomes the chain data input, 16/24-SCLK pass-through); with D5 = 0 the pin is left inactive
power-down modes: deep power-down (D2), nap (D3), auto nap (D4) and their wake-up times; CFR bits are stored only, Wake up sets D3/D2
the 4-bit CMR is not readable; the CFR read-back reply starts after the 4 command bits (the 4 result MSBs before it are the frame's normal output)
RESERVED pin (connect to AGND or +VA) is not read
variants: ADS7280 (2-to-1 MUX: +IN0/+IN1/COM, channel-select commands, TAG bit) shares ads7279.pdf; own spec. ADS7229/ADS7230 (ads7229.pdf) are the 12-bit versions with the same interface.
